battle.name: 太平天國起義
battle.brief: 1850年1月11日洪秀全在廣西桂平金田舉旗起義，太平軍靠冷兵器大軍與繳獲的舊式火槍轉戰千里，十四年內攻克長江流域數十城。卡面這件法造雷管步槍象徵了雙方裝備分野：底火免去火燧的潮濕之患，卻多數仍在清廷一方，而洋槍隊的線膛後膛槍最終令太平軍密集隊形崩散。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 太平天國方面以「天朝」自居，1853年3月攻入南京改名天京之後，建立起以洪秀全為首、諸王分封的中央體系：東王楊秀清總理朝政，南王馮雲山、西王蕭朝貴、北王韋昌輝、翼王石達開各掌兵權，軍隊按伍、卒、旅、師、將逐級編制，對外號稱百萬之眾，實際核心作戰部隊與隨軍民夫合計約數十萬。清廷方面由北京調兵，八旗、綠營是正規骨架，真正承擔戰役的卻是各省督撫自辦的團練與鄉勇。1853年曾國藩在湖南湘鄉練勇，逐步建成湘軍，以宗族與士紳為骨架、將領為核心；1862年李鴻章在江蘇招募淮軍，採購洋槍另成體系。1860年後上海一帶出現由英籍華爾創建、戈登接帶的常勝軍洋槍隊，以外籍軍官帶中國雇傭兵，裝配線膛後膛步槍與阿姆斯特朗後膛炮，與湘淮軍並肩作戰。太平軍與清廷之間還夾雜湖南、四川、江西、廣西等地的團練、會黨與地方武裝，實際形成三方以上碎片化的戰場，命令與補給都難以貫通。
countriesEn: On the Taiping side a state was built under Hong Xiuquan: after the army entered Nanjing in March 1853 and renamed it Tianjing, the movement was reorganised as a court of princes, with East Prince Yang Xiuqing handling day-to-day government, South Prince Feng Yunshan, West Prince Xiao Chaogui, North Prince Wei Changhui and Wing Prince Shi Dakai each holding a military command, and the troops graded from five-man squads through companies, brigades, divisions and corps, officially claimed to number a million while the actual striking core was several hundred thousand. On the Qing side the regular army was the Eight Banners and the Green Standard dispatched from Beijing, but the burden of the war was carried by locally raised tuanlian militia and xiangyong braves: Zeng Guofan began drilling at Xiangxiang in Hunan in 1853 and gradually assembled the Xiang Army around clan and gentry networks with serving officers as its core, and Li Hongzhang recruited the Huai Army in Jiangsu in 1862, buying foreign rifles to give it a separate character. After 1860 the Ever Victorious Army appeared on the Shanghai horizon, raised by the Englishman Frederick Townsend Ward and later led by Charles Gordon, mixing British and American officers with Chinese enlisted men and fielding rifled breech-loading rifles and Armstrong breech-loading guns beside the Xiang and Huai formations. Between the two principal armies lay a scatter of local militias, secret-society bands and regional armed groups in Hunan, Sichuan, Jiangxi and Guangxi, so that in practice the war fragmented into several overlapping theatres and neither side could run a single chain of command or supply.
people: 太平軍方面，廣東花縣客家人洪秀全連科舉落第，1843年與馮雲山在廣東廣寧創立拜上帝會，1850年1月11日在廣西桂平金田舉兵，此後以天王號令。南王馮雲山1852年5月在全州城外蓑衣渡遭伏戰歿；東王楊秀清主管日常軍政，權力最大，1856年天京事變中被洪秀全下令殺害，此事令骨幹將領互相猜疑，數十萬大軍裂成數個互不相服的山頭。西王蕭朝貴1851年3月在永安圍城戰中中炮陣亡。翼王石達開在天京事變後率部出走，轉戰江西、廣西、貴州、雲南，1863年5月在廣西鹿寨被俘，6月就義於成都。陳玉成以善打流動游擊著稱，1860年在安徽掛車河重創湘軍，1861年安慶陷落後被俘遇害。忠王李秀成是後期支柱，1860年連下蘇州、杭州，1862年大舉攻上海失利，1864年4月常州城破被俘，同年死於南京。清方以曾國藩為首，主持湖南練兵與江西軍務，弟曾國荃擔任安慶、天京攻城前線，李續賓、彭玉麟、鮑超分任將領，李鴻章以淮軍接旗，曾國藩奏報稱湘軍先後招募兵勇數十萬。僧格林沁率蒙古騎兵在北方追擊北伐軍，賽尚阿、向榮、江忠源等在長江中游與太平軍周旋。洋槍隊方面，華爾建常勝軍，1862年病逝後由戈登接帶，直至攻下常州。
peopleEn: On the Taiping side, Hong Xiuquan was a Hakka from Hua county in Guangdong who failed the imperial examinations three times; with Feng Yunshan he founded the God Worshipping Society at Guangning in Guangdong in 1843, raised the standard at Jintian in Guangxi on 11 January 1850 and thereafter ruled as the Heavenly King. South Prince Feng Yunshan was killed in an ambush at Suoyidu near Quanzhou in May 1852. East Prince Yang Xiuqing ran the daily government, held the greatest authority, and was put to death by Hong Xiuquan during the Tianjing incident of 1856, after which the senior commanders turned against one another and an army of hundreds of thousands split into rival camps. West Prince Xiao Chaogui was killed by a cannon shot during the siege of Yong'an in March 1851. Wing Prince Shi Dakai walked out after the Tianjing incident, campaigned through Jiangxi, Guangxi, Guizhou and Yunnan, was captured at Luzhai in Guangxi in May 1863 and executed at Chengdu that June. Chen Yucheng was famed for mobile strikes, inflicted a heavy defeat on the Xiang Army at Guachehe in Anhui in 1860 and was captured and killed after the fall of Anqing in 1861. The Loyal King Li Xiucheng carried the later war, taking Suzhou and Hangzhou in 1860, failing before Shanghai in 1862, being taken prisoner at the fall of Changzhou in April 1864 and dying in Nanjing the same year. On the Qing side Zeng Guofan led the Hunan drilling effort and the Jiangxi operations, his younger brother Zeng Guoquan taking the siege lines at Anqing and Tianjing, with Li Xubin, Peng Yulin and Bao Chao as commanders and Li Hongzhang bringing in the Huai Army, Zeng's own memorials recording that the Xiang Army recruited tens of thousands of braves over the years. Sengge Rinchen led Mongol cavalry against the Northern Expedition, while Sai Shang'a, Xiang Rong and Jiang Zhongyuan contested the middle Yangtze with the Taiping. Among the foreign contingents Ward founded the Ever Victorious Army and died in 1862, after which Gordon led it through the taking of Changzhou.
kits: 卡面這件雷管步槍是1840年法國設計的底火擊發步槍，槍身仍屬前裝，膛線初具雛形，最大價值不在射速而在可靠性：錘擊底火即可擊發，不必再靠火燧打火，潮濕多霧的南方戰場上因此不會像燧發槍那樣啞火。這正是太平軍最缺的一環。金田起義時拜上帝會眾只有冷兵器和少量繳自地方團練的抬槍，密集的長矛、朴刀、大刀與藤牌構成主力，火槍手多為土製獵槍與鳥槍，精度與射速都低。太平軍靠連續的縱隊衝鋒與突襲攻城取勝，1853年進軍長江時才大量繳獲綠營與湖南團練的雷管步槍及各式抬槍，並在南京設廠修造兵器、製作火藥與攻城器械。真正拉開精度差距的是清方：湘軍長期使用燧發抬槍，一杆槍要十餘人抬行；1860年後湘淮軍購入外洋雷管後膛線膛步槍，常勝軍洋槍隊更配備阿姆斯特朗後膛炮，蘇州與常州的城牆缺口正是靠這批砲火打開的。太平軍攻城則大量使用炸藥包與地道，也有用水營船隻結寨封鎖水路的做法，馬匹在北伐途中擴張成數千騎兵的隊伍，湘軍以劈山炮、長江水師與沉船佈雷回應水營。
kitsEn: The rifle on the card is a French percussion musket design of 1840, still muzzle-loading and only lightly rifled; its value lay less in rate of fire than in reliability, since a blow on the percussion cap ignited the charge without the need to strike a flint, so the weapon did not misfire in the damp, foggy weather of the southern theatre. That was exactly the weakness the Taiping suffered. At Jintian the God Worshipping Society had only cold weapons and a few muzzleloaders taken from local militia: long spears, pole blades, broadswords and rattan shields made up the core, while the firearms were mostly homemade hunting guns and bird guns of poor accuracy and slow reload. Victory came from repeated column assaults and surprise sieges; only in the advance down the Yangtze did the army capture large numbers of percussion muskets and other muzzleloaders from the Green Standard and the Hunan militia, and it set up workshops in Nanjing to repair weapons and produce powder and siege gear. The real gap in accuracy was opened on the Qing side: the Xiang Army long used flintlock muzzleloaders that needed a dozen men to carry one, and after 1860 the Xiang and Huai armies bought foreign percussion breech-loading rifled rifles while the Ever Victorious Army added Armstrong breech-loading guns, and the breaches opened in the walls of Suzhou and Changzhou were made by that artillery. The Taiping in turn relied heavily on powder charges and saps for siege work, sometimes anchoring boat camps to close a waterway; their cavalry swelled to several thousand horsemen during the Northern Expedition, while the Xiang answered with mountain guns, a river fleet and sunken vessels with mines to seal off the Taiping water camps.
tactics: 太平軍的戰術核心是速度與人數。一支大軍分成若干縱隊，前鋒以冷兵器突擊守軍薄弱面，後隊緊隨填補，兩翼由騎兵與火槍隊掩護，戰鬥一旦接觸便以刀矛近身纏鬥。行軍多沿水陸要道與省界轉折處，避開清軍設防的城池，以鄉村墟市為夜宿地，靠沿途徵糧與取食於敵維持補給，糧道制度極為原始，轉戰千里全靠就地搜括。攻城是太平軍的絕活：築土堆逼近，掘地道埋火藥炸牆，或用水營船隻結寨封鎖水路，1853年7月三江口水戰即以舟師配合岸上步卒，1864年天京城牆最終也在這樣的爆破下崩潰。守方清軍初期靠綠營的長程火力與城頭火炮死守，1853年後局面逆轉，湘軍以結硬寨打呆戰著稱，步步為營，先挖壕溝、築土圍再攻，專打援軍而不急於攻城，後勤靠湖南鄉紳籌款與釐金制度支撐，用持久消耗戰對付太平軍的銳氣。1860年後常勝軍以線膛後膛步槍在兩三百步外精確射擊，炮隊以阿姆斯特朗炮壓制城頭，再用器械爆破配合湘淮軍步兵突入，1862年太平軍攻上海時因缺乏攻城重炮而在租界外折戟，也是同一道理。
tacticsEn: The Taiping method was speed and mass. A great army was broken into several columns: the vanguard struck the weak face of a position with cold weapons, the units behind closed up to feed the assault, and the flanks were screened by cavalry and firing parties; once contact was made the engagement degenerated into close fighting with blade and spear. Movements ran along the main roads and waterways and the turning points of provincial boundaries, avoiding the fortified cities, and the troops slept at night in villages and market towns, drawing grain from the countryside as they went and living off the enemy's resources, because their supply system was primitive in the extreme and a march of a thousand li was sustained by foraging on the spot. Siegecraft was their strong suit: they built earthen approaches, dug saps to plant powder charges against the walls, or anchored boat camps to close a waterway, as at the Sanjiangkou engagement in July 1853 where a river flotilla worked with the infantry ashore, and the walls of Tianjing finally came down the same way in 1864. The early Qing defence relied on the Green Standard's longer-range fire and on wall-mounted guns, but after 1853 the situation inverted, and the Xiang Army became famous for the method of building hard stockades and fighting dull battles: advancing step by step, digging trenches and raising earthen works before attacking, concentrating on relieving armies rather than rushing a siege, and sustained by a supply system financed by Hunan gentry through private subscription and the lijin levy, so that a war of attrition wore down the Taiping élan. After 1860 the Ever Victorious Army engaged with rifled breech-loading rifles at two or three hundred paces, used Armstrong guns to silence the walls, and then used blasting to open a way for the Xiang and Huai infantry; the Taiping attack on Shanghai in 1862 failed for the same reason, lacking heavy siege guns before the foreign settlement.
data: 兵力數字要分清兩個帳。1850年1月金田起義時能投入作戰的核心人員約兩千，絕大多數只有矛與刀；1851年3月永安封王時軍隊增至數萬；1853年3月進軍南京時對外號稱百萬，實際核心作戰部隊連同隨軍民夫約數十萬，其中很大一部分是沿途強行編入的抬夫與新附之地。湘軍1853年在湖南初練時約三千人，至1864年前後，據曾國藩奏報與地方文獻，先後招募兵勇多達數十萬，裁汰之後常備在十餘萬上下；淮軍1862年首批約五千，隨後擴至數萬；常勝軍陸軍人數最多不過五六千，其中洋槍隊僅數百至數千。戰役層面：1858年11月三河之戰，李續賓所部三千餘人被陳玉成、李秀成數萬大軍全殲；安慶自1860年10月圍打到1861年4月，歷時約八個月，守軍萬餘最終全滅；1864年常州之戰自3月打到4月，李秀成率數萬援軍未能扭轉；天京自1862年被圍至1864年7月破城，圍城約兩年。距離方面，金田到南京約二千餘里、歷時近一年；北伐自南京直抵天津，亦約二千餘里、耗時兩年，才被僧格林沁與勝保等截斷。
dataEn: The troop numbers have to be read from two separate ledgers. In January 1850 the fighting core that could be committed at Jintian was about two thousand men, almost all of them armed with spear and blade; by the ennoblement at Yong'an in March 1851 the army had grown to several tens of thousands; on entering Nanjing in March 1853 it claimed a million, while the real core of combat troops together with camp followers came to several hundred thousand, a large part of them porters and new districts pressed into service along the march. The Xiang Army began in Hunan in 1853 with about three thousand men; by 1864, according to Zeng Guofan's memorials and local records, it had recruited tens of thousands more over the years, settling after the churn at around a hundred thousand in constant service; the Huai Army's first contingent in 1862 was about five thousand and later grew to tens of thousands; the Ever Victorious Army never exceeded five or six thousand men, of whom the foreign-drilled rifle companies numbered only several hundred at most. At the level of engagements: in November 1858 at Sanhe the three thousand men under Li Xubin were annihilated by the armies of Chen Yucheng and Li Xiucheng; the siege of Anqing ran from October 1860 to April 1861, about eight months, and the garrison of more than ten thousand was wiped out; at Changzhou in 1864 the fighting ran from March into April and the tens of thousands Li Xiucheng brought up could not turn the result; Tianjing stood besieged for about two years before it fell in July 1864. As for distance: Jintian to Nanjing is some two thousand li and took close to a year, while the Northern Expedition pushed from Nanjing towards Tianjin over roughly the same distance in two years before Sengge Rinchen, Shengbao and their colleagues cut it off.
cause: 直接引爆點是鴉片戰爭之後清廷的財政崩潰與廣西秩序失序。戰後賠款分攤到各省，漕運停滯，糧價飛漲，廣西官吏胥吏盤剝，客民與土民械鬥連年，盜匪橫行，湘桂一帶的天地會與燒香會層層疊起。1843年洪秀全三試不第，返鄉途中病中夢見上帝，與馮雲山、蕭朝貴在廣東廣寧山區秘密結社拜上帝會，把客家礦工、燒炭工、團練失業者與流民以宗教互助的名義組織起來，主張天父下凡、天下太平，避開了直接反清的言辭，卻在暗處蓄起另一套秩序。1847年教眾遷入廣西紫荊山與桂平金田一帶囤積糧械、操練結陣，1849年冬洪秀全歸隊時已聚眾數千，隨即以太平軍名號起兵。表面是宗教起義，內裡是客家群體在廣西的生存競爭、地方治理崩壞與清廷攤派回彈三者交疊的產物。
causeEn: The immediate trigger was the collapse of Qing finance and the breakdown of order in Guangxi after the Opium War. The war indemnities were passed down to the provinces, canal transport was interrupted, grain prices rocketed, and in Guangxi clerks and tax farmers ground down the people, with feuds between Hakka settlers and local villagers running year after year and brigands on every road, while Tiandihui bands and incense-burning congregations piled up across Hunan and Guangxi. After failing the examinations for the third time, Hong Xiuquan fell ill on the road home in 1843 and in his fever dreamed of God; with Feng Yunshan and Xiao Chaogui he formed the God Worshipping Society in the mountains of Guangning in Guangdong, drawing Hakka miners, charcoal burners, disbanded militia and vagrants together under the language of religious mutual aid and asserting that the Heavenly Father had come down and the world was to be made level, avoiding open anti-Qing words while building an alternative order in the dark. In 1847 the believers moved into Zijing mountain and the Jintian area of Guangxi, stockpiling grain and weapons and drilling their formations; when Hong Xiuquan rejoined them in the winter of 1849 several thousand had already gathered, and the decision was taken to rise under the name of the Taiping Army. On the surface a religious revolt, inwardly the product of three overlapping pressures: the Hakka struggle for survival in Guangxi, the collapse of local government, and the rebound of levies pushed onto the people.
impact: 這場戰爭改變的不只是江山，而是清的軍隊與財政結構。綠營、八旗在消耗戰中失去戰鬥力，地方督撫靠湘軍、淮軍自行募兵、籌餉、就地作戰，中央對地方軍權與財權的約束力被削弱，清廷此後再無法單靠制式軍隊維持統治。軍備方面，湘淮軍在與洋商交易中大量購進雷管後膛線膛步槍、阿姆斯特朗炮與新式後膛炮，常勝軍的成軍更把西洋火器與中國兵卒合編成一種新編制，直接催生了安慶內軍械所、江南製造總局等近代兵工與洋務事業，晚清陸軍裝備由前裝燧發走向後裝線膛的路線在此定型。制度層面，太平天國在南京推行的田產清查、考試選官、資政文書與天朝田畝制度雖隨城陷而廢，卻留下早期近代行政的試驗痕跡。對外關係上，戰爭牽動長江航運與通商口岸，英法美各懷算盤而介入其中，列強對清廷的施壓與清廷的自我覺醒同步加深，太平天國一役因此成為晚清軍事轉型的起點之一。
impactEn: What this war changed was not merely who ruled the country, but the structure of Qing armies and finances. The Green Standard and the Eight Banners spent up as an effective fighting force, and provincial governors raised and paid their own troops through the Xiang and Huai armies and fought their own battles, which loosened central control over regional military and fiscal power to a degree the court could never repair. In weapons, the Xiang and Huai armies bought large quantities of percussion breech-loading rifled rifles, Armstrong guns and other modern artillery from foreign merchants, and the formation of the Ever Victorious Army fused Western guns with Chinese soldiers into a new kind of unit, directly feeding the rise of the Anqing Nanyang Arsenal, the Jiangnan Manufacturing Bureau and the wider self-strengthening programme; the route from flint and muzzle-loading to breech-loading rifled equipment was fixed during this war. Institutionally, the land surveys, the examinations for office, the Zizheng documents and the Tianchao Tianmu system tried out in Nanjing died with the city, but left behind traces of early modern administrative experiment. Externally, the war unsettled the Yangtze shipping and the treaty ports, drew Britain, France and the United States into a tangle of their own interests, and increased both foreign pressure on the court and the court's awareness of its own weakness; in that sense the Taiping war was one of the starting points of late Qing military transformation.
result: 1864年6月1日洪秀全在天京病逝，幼子洪天貴福出逃，7月19日湘軍攻入天京，太平天國主力覆亡。殘部在各地陸續抵抗多年：石達開1863年6月在成都被處死，陳玉成1861年遇害，李秀成1864年兵敗被俘、同年死於南京，李定國與孫可望退入雲貴，與清廷對抗到明清鼎革前後方告終結，天京之外的零散部隊多改以天地會、捻軍與地方團練的名義延續。從兵器角度收尾這條線最貼切：太平軍自始至終靠冷兵器大軍與繳獲的舊式火槍維持十四年，最終並非輸在戰鬥意志，而是輸在射擊精度、攻城火炮與後勤制度三者的差距；湘淮軍與常勝軍用線膛後膛步槍與後膛炮完成最後的城牆突破時，正好印證了卡面那句話：射程一變長，靠人堆起來的隊形就會散。
resultEn: Hong Xiuquan died of illness in Tianjing on 1 June 1864 and his son Hong Tiangui fled; the Xiang Army entered the city on 19 July and the main body of the Taiping state collapsed. Remnants resisted for years afterwards: Shi Dakai was executed at Chengdu in June 1863, Chen Yucheng was killed in 1861, Li Xiucheng was defeated and captured at Changzhou and died in Nanjing the same year, while Li Dingguo and Sun Kewang withdrew into Yunnan and Guizhou and fought on into the Ming-Qing transition, and the scattered bands outside Tianjing carried on mainly under the names of the Tiandihui, the Nian and local militia. The closing of the line is most neatly drawn at the level of weapons: the Taiping held out for fourteen years on cold weapons and captured old muskets, and were not finally beaten by any failure of will but by the gap in shooting accuracy, siege artillery and supply organisation; when the Xiang and Huai armies and the Ever Victorious Army broke the last walls with rifled breech-loading rifles and breech-loading guns, they proved precisely the sentence on the card: once the range lengthened, formations built out of masses of men came apart.
